log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed 6 quick (morning). Watch pool in press conferences. Aim ~6-8 kills/day to reach 30 in 5 days for multiplier; stop if pool nears 1000.

Day1: 6 quick morning kills. Day2: 8 quick morning kills (spread over places). Pool 40000 after day1 (morning-only rules out day workers and students). Keep killing in the morning only. Aim for 8 or more kills a day for the 40-in-5-days multiplier. Watch the pool and back off if it nears about 3000.
log.reasoning:
I'm weighing how much to kill. The pool fell to 40000 after day one with three traced deaths, and I need to stay above 1000 to avoid losing half the points. Killing national victims seems safe since it reveals nothing, while others carry trace risk, with about five traces per day among the deaths. I'm checking whether the three traced deaths on day one counted national victims or not.

I'm settling on a plan of eight kills per day, since reaching 40 points over five days needs that pace. Spreading the kills across different places should keep any three traces from piling up in one spot.
